name: Multifunctional Soft Play Set Baby Gym - Earth Pastel
description:
Multifunctional Soft Play Set Baby Gym is a canvas for your child's creativity. With various shapes and sizes, it offers endless possibilities for imaginative play, construction, and exploration. Watch as your child transforms their ideas into tangible creations, actively enhancing their problem-solving, spatial reasoning, and critical thinking skills. It's a fun way to learn through play.

  • Encourages physical activity

  • Boosts creativity & imagination

  • Helps release excess energy & manage stress

  • Provides sensory stimulation

  • Keeps children off screens

  • Promotes social skills like sharing & collaborating

  • Age group: 0.5 - 5 years

IGLU's gentle, huggable shapes are like buddies for developing a wide range of movement and motor skills in kids. Different shapes help kids boost their coordination and motor skills – from wiggling fingers to crawling, climbing, and exploring heights.

Sharing giggles with siblings, friends, and buddies turbocharges social skills by sparking chats and connections.

Teaming up with parents or pals leads to speedy learning and spotting cool geometric shapes and vivid colors. The endless mix of shapes is like a treasure trove for crafting imaginative worlds – castles, forts, and more.

As kids grow, these shapes morph into excellent tools. Building obstacle courses, playing games, and conquering steps to beds or chairs – the possibilities are endless. Even pets join in the fun, using shapes as toys and adults get crafty – imagine shapes as a trusty computer stand!

  • Very durable – made from HQ foam. Dense yet light foam that holds its shape.

  • Easy clean-up - wipes clean with a wet wipe.

  • Handmade - from sewing to packaging, everything is handmade.

  • Certificates - the blocks get vigorously tested and have received safety certificates in EU, USA, Canada and UK.

  • Made in EU - everything is made from our local Northern Europe facility.

IGLU Soft blocks are made of firm, 100% recyclable high-quality foam with a closed cell structure – soft & super light.  Covered with a tough artificial eco-leather. Shapes are robust, pleasant to the touch, easy to care for, retain shape well, and tested for harmful substances.

IGLU products are CE marked according to EU Directive 88/378 / EEC: Toy Safety, making them absolutely safe for toddlers.

name: Safety and Comfort 5 Mat Set - Grey Beige
description:
Each mat in this set is designed to provide a secure, cushioned surface, reducing the risk of injuries during playtime. This set includes five individual mats. Use them for active play, quiet reading, naptime, or even as a protective surface for learning to crawl. They provide a gentle and supportive space for your child's every move.

  • Encourages physical activity

  • Boosts creativity & imagination

  • Helps release excess energy & manage stress

  • Provides sensory stimulation

  • Keeps children off screens

  • Promotes social skills like sharing & collaborating

IGLU's gentle, huggable shapes are like buddies for developing a wide range of movement and motor skills in kids. Different shapes help kids boost their coordination and motor skills – from wiggling fingers to crawling, climbing, and exploring heights.

Sharing giggles with siblings, friends, and buddies turbocharges social skills by sparking chats and connections.

Teaming up with parents or pals leads to speedy learning and spotting cool geometric shapes and vivid colors. The endless mix of shapes is like a treasure trove for crafting imaginative worlds – castles, forts, and more.

As kids grow, these shapes morph into excellent tools. Building obstacle courses, playing games, and conquering steps to beds or chairs – the possibilities are endless. Even pets join in the fun, using shapes as toys and adults get crafty – imagine shapes as a trusty computer stand!

  • Very durable – made from HQ foam. Dense yet light foam that holds its shape.

  • Easy clean-up - wipes clean with a wet wipe.

  • Handmade - from sewing to packaging, everything is handmade.

  • Certificates - the blocks get vigorously tested and have received safety certificates in EU, USA, Canada and UK.

  • Made in EU - everything is made from our local Northern Europe facility.

IGLU Soft blocks are made of firm, 100% recyclable high-quality foam with a closed cell structure – soft & super light.  Covered with a tough artificial eco-leather. Shapes are robust, pleasant to the touch, easy to care for, retain shape well, and tested for harmful substances.

IGLU products are CE marked according to EU Directive 88/378 / EEC: Toy Safety, making them absolutely safe for toddlers.

name: Lions Teepee Tent
description:
Create a magical place for your little ones with our premium kids teepee tent, handcrafted to inspire years of imaginative play and cozy relaxation.
Whether it's a secret reading nook in the bedroom or a stylish children's play tent in the living room, our teepee blends seamlessly into your home decor while providing a dedicated space for your child to flourish.
Designed for both indoor use and outdoor fun on sunny days, this handmade teepee offers a safe, breathable environment that protects from light wind and sun.

  • Safety First: Includes a dedicated tipi stabilizer to ensure the structure remains upright and secure during even the most active play sessions.

  • EU Craftsmanship: Proudly handmade in Poland using high-quality, 100% OEKO-TEX certified cotton that meets strict European safety standards.

  • Easy Maintenance: We know play can get messy - the fabric tent, floor mat, and textile accessories are all fully machine washable.

  • Quick Assembly: Simple to install and just as easy to fold away when you need to reclaim your floor space.

Included:

  • Fabric Teepee Tent: Featuring a built-in window for "peek-a-boo" fun.

  • Padded Floor Mat: Creates a soft, comfortable base for playing or napping.

  • 4 Natural Wooden Poles: Sturdy support for the structure.

  • Teepee Stabilizer: Prevents the poles from sliding or the tent from collapsing.

Materials:

  • Fabric: 100% Cotton (220 g), certified Oeko-Tex (safe for sensitive skin).

  • Poles: Natural, smooth-sanded pine wood.

  • Fillings: The mat is filled with anti-allergenic non-woven polyester, also certified Oeko-Tex.

Dimensions:

  • Tent base size: 100 x 100 cm

  • Tent Height: 160 cm

  • Pole Length: 180 cm

Note: Other decorative elements shown in the photos are for display purposes only.

name: TOKU Rome Women’s Sandals – Cow Limited Edition
description:
TOKU Rome women’s sandals – Cow limited edition

TOKU Rome is a minimalist slip-on women’s sandal made in Europe by award-winning brand TOKU. Inspired by the long history of the Mediterranean, it combines natural leather, a supportive anatomical insole and a flexible outsole for everyday comfort.

The upper is made from natural leather. The anatomical insole supports the foot and is covered with velour. The outsole is made from flexible and durable polyurethane (PU), which does not mark floors.

With each pair, you’re investing in the craft of a family-run business from southern Estonia that has been creating high-quality footwear since 1927. Dedicated to the principles of slow fashion, TOKU uses natural, premium materials to create versatile and long-lasting styles, ensuring your sandals remain a staple in your wardrobe for years to come.

The jury at the Estonian Design Awards has described TOKU as “the new Estonian classic.”

The Cow model is a limited edition and will not be restocked once sold out. Order now while it is still available.

name: TOKU bag Lisbon - Purple
description:
The Lisbon bag from award-winning brand TOKU is made for everyday adventures and stylish trips. Elegant and practical, it combines quality design with thoughtful functionality, making it a great companion for city days, travel and everything in between.

Handmade in the EU from natural leather, the bag is durable and has a luxurious look that will last for years. Each bag is handmade from genuine leather, which means every piece is unique. Natural leather may vary slightly in color, texture and pattern.

The minimalist, timeless design makes it easy to pair with any outfit and occasion. The bag is spacious enough to fit your daily essentials.

It has a zipper closure and a long adjustable strap with a buckle, so you can wear it around your waist, over your shoulder, carry it by hand or style it however you like.

Inside, there is an extra pocket and a key ring, so your keys and other small items are always easy to find.

Inspired by the colorful street culture and fast pace of Lisbon.

Size: 25 × 17 × 7 cm
